title: AzGui
description: A colorful yet simplistic gui made to be pleasant and unobtrusive!
body:
### Color
This pack uses bright and pastel-like colors to change up the monotomy of vanilla gui's
- - -
### Minimalism
Instead of the usual clunky interfaces AzGui gives back a lot of screen space while not cutting down on any functionality
- - -
